name: Christopher Duncan
story: Christopher Duncan provides a person-level link between GIS data translation and the later enterprise-integration market. Seamless Data identifies him as CTO/COO, while the company’s history traces its origins through Traverse, a New Zealand mapping and geospatial specialist and Safe Software/FME partner, into a broader data and application integration business.
